facts.value: The Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) (Hons) degree offers a broad choice of options which will enhance employability on graduation.
The BBS degree at UL is among the most popular business courses in Ireland.
The Kemmy Business School achieved EQUIS, AMBA and AACSB accreditation.
The Kemmy Business School is listed amongst the top 1% of business schools worldwide.
You will study the core business principles of accounting, economics, risk management and insurance, human resource management and marketing.
You will specialise in one area as your 'major' in the second semester of Year 2.
Theory will be brought to life through work on practical business projects in addition to an eight month work placement in industry.
